verdict.rationale: Perplexity's Assistant (drafting emails, scheduling, booking) and the browser extension's 'Contextual Understanding' (answers tied to current page/domain) and 'Your Library' (curation of past discoveries) show the product surfacing suggestions tied to a user's own activity/context, but there's no explicit feature for uploading or connecting personal datasets (docs, CRM, files) and generating proactive analytical insights from them — the core product is web search/answers, not user-data analytics. missing for 10: dedicated personal-data ingestion/analysis capability, proactive insight-generation dashboards, independent evidence these 'insights' features work well in practice (community reports flag research features stalling and answer quality issues).
